body:
Re-checked on the current version, as requested.

**Environment**
- `omo --version`: `omo 5.1.59 (engine: senpi 2026.11.2-3; scheme nodef)` (standalone binary `omo-linux-x64`, freshly downloaded from the v5.1.59 release)
- OS: Linux x86_64 (kernel 7.0.0-31-generic), Node v22.23.2 available but the standalone binary was used
- Steps (in an isolated `REVIEW_HARNESS_HOME`-style slot, `/tmp` project dir):

**Connection-reset half** — acknowledged; awaiting senpi#5512 (still open as of today, `merged: false`). We'll re-verify our long-run supervisor behavior once it lands.

**Resume half — still reproduces on 5.1.59.** Exact repro:

```
$ omo -p --session-id c0ffee0001 "Remember the word MANGO. Reply with exactly: DONE-A"
DONE-A
$ omo -p --session-id c0ffee0002 "Remember the word PAPAYA. Reply with exactly: DONE-B"
DONE-B
$ omo -p -r c0ffee0001 "What single word did I ask you to remember earlier in this session? Answer with just the word."
```

What the `-r` invocation prints and then does: it renders the interactive session picker inside `-p` mode, listing both sessions, and waits for input that never comes in a headless context —

```
ctrl+s sort · ctrl+n named · ctrl+d delete · ctrl+p path (off)

>                                                                              

› Remember the word PAPAYA. Reply with exactly: DONE-B                      2 3m
  Remember the word MANGO. Reply with exactly: DONE-A                       2 3m

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

(no answer ever printed; killed after 60 s in the sandbox, exit 124. On 5.1.33 the same hang sat ~1 h at ~100% CPU — same failure, longer window.)

Session ids: two sessions in the same project session dir, `2026-11-03T13-18-11-435Z_c0ffee0001.jsonl` and `2026-11-03T13-18-31-986Z_c0ffee0002.jsonl` under `~/.omo/agent/sessions/--tmp-omo59x-proj--/`. The `-r c0ffee0001` run printed the picker with **both** sessions listed and selected neither; it never echoed the requested session id as "resuming".

Contrast, same binary, same dir:

```
$ omo -p --session-id c0ffee0001 "What single word did I ask you to remember earlier in this session? Answer with just the word."
MANGO
```

So `--session-id` resume is correct on 5.1.59 (right session, right context), while `-p -r <id>` is still broken: the resume picker hijacks headless mode instead of resolving the named session. Our workaround (`--session-id` on every invocation) keeps working, but the `-r` semantics in `-p` mode — resolve the id, or fail loudly — would remain worth fixing.

No keys or tokens in the outputs above.
